caption: KEDA wakes a workload from zero itself, then hands one-to-N scaling to an ordinary HPA that reads the event metric through KEDA's metrics server.
alt: An event source such as a Kafka topic or a queue is polled by a KEDA scaler running in the KEDA operator. The operator creates and owns an HPA and scales the Deployment between zero and one replica directly. The KEDA metrics server exposes the same event metric through the Kubernetes external metrics API; the HPA reads it and scales the Deployment from one to N replicas.
